title: Brake Fluid Exchanger Machine – Pure Brake Toolbox
lead: MOC has developed a new Brake Fluid Exchanger Machine (Part No. 98360) that is now available for purchase.
body: This machine does not include the Standard Brake Adapter Kit. If adapters are needed, they can be purchased separately.
benefits: Pressure gauge reads in dual scale PSI/BAR
Auto safety shutoff when new fluid is low
Handheld machine - easy to transport and store
